verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only an API route to link receipts and invoices to existing transactions. That is a developer building block where the caller supplies the file and picks the transaction. Nothing in the pack shows employee photo capture, email-forwarding intake, OCR extraction, or automatic matching to the right transaction.

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction
